acs.AC-001.1: WHEN a request to the Jira App API carries a FIT whose signature verifies against Atlassian's JWKS, whose issuer is , whose audience equals the configured app id, which is within its / window, and which has a , THE tracker SHALL pass the request to its handler with the cloudId and the principal (if any).
acs.AC-001.2: IF the  header is missing or is not a Bearer token, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 401 with MSG08 without calling the handler.
acs.AC-001.3: IF the FIT signature does not verify, or its key id is unknown after one JWKS refresh, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 401 with MSG08.
acs.AC-001.4: IF the FIT issuer is not  or its audience is not the configured app id, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 401 with MSG08.
acs.AC-001.5: IF the FIT is expired or not yet valid, or has no , THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 401 with MSG08.
acs.AC-001.7: THE tracker SHALL never write a FIT to a log or to an error response.
acs.AC-001.8: IF Atlassian's JWKS cannot be fetched and no cached key matches, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 503 with MSG06 and record the error type.
acs.AC-003.1: WHEN an "issue created" event arrives whose  is the Jira project key of an ACTIVE T-Solve Project, THE tracker SHALL store a suggestion result with that Project, the issue key, no sources, no suggested solution and no reporter answer, and respond 202.
acs.AC-003.4: IF a suggestion result for the event's issue key already exists (Forge delivered the event again), THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 202 without storing a second one or changing the existing one.
acs.AC-003.6: IF the event body is not a valid "issue created" event (no issue key, or no ), THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 400 with MSG06 and store nothing.
acs.AC-003.8: IF the event's project key is not the Jira project key of an ACTIVE T-Solve Project, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 202 and store nothing.
acs.AC-007.1: WHEN a principal linked to an active T-Solve user requests panel data for an issue of a T-Solve Project, THE tracker SHALL return the stored suggestions (as search allows that user, including MSG76 when search is not available to them) and the Solution Form state from the ticket package: AI draft or MSG67, unsubmitted draft (MSG77), submitted and awaiting review (MSG65), or changes requested (MSG64).
acs.AC-007.2: IF the principal is not linked to a T-Solve user, THEN THE tracker SHALL return panel data that only asks the user to sign in (MSG62), plus the MSG81 question when STORY-010 applies.
acs.AC-007.3: IF the principal is linked to a deactivated T-Solve user, THEN THE tracker SHALL return panel data with MSG10 and nothing else.
acs.AC-007.4: IF the issue's project is not a T-Solve Project, THEN THE tracker SHALL return panel data that says the project is not connected, with no suggestions.
acs.AC-007.5: WHEN a linked active user asks to search again, THE tracker SHALL read the issue's current summary and description from Jira, ask search to recompute suggestions, and return them.
acs.AC-007.6: IF search or Jira does not answer within 20 seconds, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 503 with MSG06.
acs.AC-008.1: WHEN a linked active user saves the Solution Form as a draft, THE tracker SHALL pass it to the ticket package with that T-Solve user as author and return the result.
acs.AC-008.2: WHEN a linked active user finishes the Solution Form, THE tracker SHALL pass it to the ticket package with that T-Solve user as author and return the result.
acs.AC-008.3: WHEN a linked active user closes the Solution Form opened after resolving the issue, THE tracker SHALL submit an empty Solution for review through the ticket package (MSG70).
acs.AC-008.4: IF the principal is not linked to an active T-Solve user, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 403 with MSG62 and not call the ticket package.
acs.AC-008.5: IF the ticket package rejects the request, THEN THE tracker SHALL return its error and message code unchanged.
acs.AC-010.1: WHILE the issue's suggestion result has a suggested solution (the MSG80 comment) and no reporter answer, and the principal is the issue's reporter, THE tracker SHALL include the MSG81 question in the panel data, even if the principal is not linked to a T-Solve user.
acs.AC-010.2: WHEN the reporter answers Yes or No, THE tracker SHALL store the answer and its time in the issue's suggestion result and return MSG82 for Yes or MSG83 for No.
acs.AC-010.3: IF the principal is not the issue's reporter, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 403 with MSG08 and not record an answer.
acs.AC-010.4: IF the issue has no suggestion result with a suggested solution, or it was already answered, THEN THE tracker SHALL respond 409 with MSG06 and not record an answer.
